evidence_objects_storage.name: evidence_objects_storage
evidence_objects_storage.value: ("evidence_objects"."storage" = 'inline' and "evidence_objects"."sealed" is not null and "evidence_objects"."storage_key" is null and octet_length("evidence_objects"."sealed") <= 1049600) or ("evidence_objects"."storage" = 'bucket' and "evidence_objects"."storage_key" is not null and "evidence_objects"."sealed" is null)

moderation_flags_signal.name: moderation_flags_signal
moderation_flags_signal.value: ("moderation_flags"."origin" = 'human') or ("moderation_flags"."origin" = 'hash_list' and "moderation_flags"."tier" = 't0' and "moderation_flags"."list_category" is not null and "moderation_flags"."distance" is not null) or ("moderation_flags"."origin" = 'classifier' and "moderation_flags"."tier" in ('t1', 't2') and "moderation_flags"."category" is not null and "moderation_flags"."score" is not null)
